name: nametag
description: Offline PWA and Android app: bulk renamer for files, folders and ZIPs with pattern analysis and portable JSON undo, extension renamer, and an audio tag editor with backups.

scripts.test: node tests/renamer.test.mjs && node tests/portable.test.mjs && node tests/saf.test.mjs && node tests/tags.test.mjs && node tests/parallel.test.mjs && node tests/native.test.mjs
scripts.android:prepare: npx cap add android && node scripts/android/prepare.mjs && npx cap sync android
